description: Canonical finite-agent registry. Trigger Manager manages its own entries; robot-operator-owned workflows remain outside Trigger Manager runtime.

memoryContentModeOptions.all: All content - includes both user messages and AI responses
memoryContentModeOptions.user: User only - reflects on user inputs, excluding verbose AI responses (recommended)
memoryContentModeOptions.agent: Agent only - reflects on AI responses, dreams, and system outputs

audio-organizer.description: Processes the audio inbox into transcripts and memories when explicitly requested.
audio-organizer.comment: Finite one-shot work. Never starts on boot and always receives a durable coordinator task id.

organizer.comment: Sleep Workflow child. It can still be run manually, but has no independent Semi or Full autonomy timer.

curator.comment: Sleep Workflow child. It can still be run manually, but has no independent Semi or Full autonomy timer.

sleep-workflow.comment: Sole automatic owner of the sequential memory organization, curation, desire, dreaming, persona-review, and indexing pipeline.

boredom-observer.description: Triggers the editable Boredom Observer workflow, which requests one current camera image and routes the result to Boredom Autonomy.
boredom-observer.comment: Finite trigger owned and scheduled by Robot Operator. The named workflow contains the camera request and editable observation stimulus; Boredom Autonomy makes the semantic decision.

boredom-movement.description: Triggers the editable Boredom Movement workflow, which prompts Boredom Autonomy to select one advertised movement.
boredom-movement.comment: Finite trigger owned and scheduled by Robot Operator. Its named workflow contains the editable movement policy; Boredom Autonomy selects and evaluates the consequence through canonical execution nodes.

boredom-reflection.description: Triggers the editable Boredom Reflection workflow, which samples memory and prompts Boredom Autonomy for a meaningful consequence.
boredom-reflection.comment: Finite trigger owned and scheduled by Robot Operator. Its named workflow contains memory sampling and the editable reflection stimulus; Boredom Autonomy owns the semantic consequence.

reflector.comment: 70% chance to reflect after 15 min of inactivity - not guaranteed, feels more organic

contentModeOptions.all: User and AI history - generated dreams, reflections, and inner dialogue are excluded
contentModeOptions.user: User only - reflects on user inputs, excluding verbose AI responses (recommended)
contentModeOptions.agent: Agent only - reflects on AI responses and system outputs; generated inner content is excluded

curiosity.comment: Trigger Manager admits this agent after 15 minutes of conversation inactivity.

curiosity-researcher.comment: Independently researches one pending user-facing curiosity question per cycle using local memory. Curiosity Service remains the separate question-asking owner.

inner-curiosity.comment: Generates self-directed questions and answers them using local memory. Saves as inner_dialogue (never shows in chat).

psychoanalyzer.comment: Manual-run agent that reviews recent memories with psychotherapist model and incrementally updates persona. Run via: ./bin/mh agent run psychoanalyzer

desire-generator.comment: Sleep Workflow child. It can still be run manually, but has no independent Semi or Full autonomy timer.

desire-executor.comment: Sleep Workflow child. Existing trust and approval checks remain authoritative; there is no independent Semi or Full autonomy timer.

desire-planner.comment: Sleep Workflow child. It can still be run manually, but has no independent Semi or Full autonomy timer.

desire-outcome-reviewer.comment: Sleep Workflow child. It can still be run manually, but has no independent Semi or Full autonomy timer.

profile-sync.comment: Full profile synchronization with remote server. Handles: authentication, profile bundle download (persona/config), credentials sync, memory sync. Fully replaces client-side syncFromRemoteServer. Supports --pull-only, --memories-only, --profile-only, --days=N, --user=<username> flags.

memory-sync.comment: Syncs memories with remote server. Triggered manually via UI, on login (pull-only), or can be scheduled. Supports --pull-only, --push-only, and --user=<username> flags.

mood.description: Reviews recent conversation or inner dialogue and selects an enabled persona facet through the editable Mood Persona Review graph.
mood.comment: Disabled by default. When enabled, queues one Mood graph review after every 10 user messages. After 30 minutes without a conversation event, queues the same graph in baseline-reset mode.

daydreamer.comment: 15% chance to generate a brief daydream after 5 min idle. Inner dialogue only - never surfaces to main chat. Lighter than full dreams.
